free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial is published on the plan page; the cheapest plan is Sidekick Pro at EUR 11.99 per month including VAT (Chaos, the cheapest 10 Gbit plan, is EUR 19.99 per month).
free_tier.notes: A 7-day refund window is stated; conditions apply.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: sold by total disk (1500 GB on Sidekick Pro); no single-file cap is published

retention.stated: for the life of the subscription; no inactivity deletion is stated

egress.terms: Sidekick Pro has a 2 Gbit incoming and 1 Gbit outgoing link with 5 TB of upload per month; past it 'your upload bandwidth gets throttled to 10Mbps' unless extra traffic is bought. The 'Unmetered' plans start at EUR 16.99 per month.
egress.free_allowance: 5 TB upload per month on Sidekick Pro; downloads are not capped

interface_detail: The vendor lists FTP, FTPS, SFTP and HTTP access with browser-based apps; root access is not included on Sidekick Pro.
tooling: FTP, FTPS or SFTP client and the vendor dashboard with a one-click app list; no API or CLI is documented
chaining: A EUR 11.99 1.5 TB seedbox with a 5 TB monthly upload allowance; the Unmetered plans (EUR 16.99 and up) forbid public trackers

limits.value: 5 TB upload per month on Sidekick Pro, then throttled to 10 Mbps
2 Gbit incoming and 1 Gbit outgoing on the Premium 1Gbit plans; 10 Gbit on the Racer plans

limits_note: Racer 10Gbit plans: Chaos 1500 GB EUR 19.99 with 8 TB upload, Super Villain 4000 GB EUR 39.99 with 20 TB upload. Premium plans: Sidekick Pro 1500 GB EUR 11.99, Hero Pro 2000 GB EUR 17.99. Unmetered plans: Sidekick NL 1500 GB EUR 16.99.
binding_note: At 1 TiB per month nothing fails on the 5 TB upload allowance; the 1500 GB disk and the throttle past 5 TB are the limits.

identity_cost.detail: The register page offers sign-up through a Google, Facebook, Twitter or GitHub account; the vendor states it keeps 'an absolute minimum of personal details'. Payment is by PayPal, card, Revolut or crypto. Phone and document requirements are not stated.

reliability_note: Upload is capped at 5 TB a month on the cheapest plan; a crypto payment page was marked temporarily unavailable in the vendor's news list.
confidence_note: Plans, prices and caps are on the vendor home page read on 2026-11-03 through a raw fetch converted to text. A measured rung needs a slot and a timed transfer.
